title: **Semnan Red Crescent:** 20 people and 11 vehicles that were trapped in flooding and water accumulation at an industrial park and at Semnan University of Medical Sciences were rescued with the help of Red Crescent relief workers.
text:
**Semnan Red Crescent:** 20 people and 11 vehicles that were trapped in flooding and water accumulation at an industrial park and at Semnan University of Medical Sciences were rescued with the help of Red Crescent relief workers."

"**Context for foreign readers:**  "

"This report refers to flooding on **3 November** in **Semnan**, a city in north-central Iran. "

"According to the **Semnan branch of the Red Crescent Society**, flash flooding/standing water trapped people and vehicles at two locations—an industrial park and the Semnan University of Medical Sciences. "

"Red Crescent rescue teams were able to rescue **20 people** and **11 vehicles**. "

"Source: **IRIB News**.
